metadata.title: Abstract Security - Value & ROI workbook
metadata.description: Sentinel workbook quantifying the Abstract x Sentinel value: volume/cost reduction (aggregation & dedupe from aggregation_count, upstream filtering), enrichment coverage, and detection/hunt/AI-SOC effectiveness with a parameterized cost model.
metadata.author: Abstract Security - Solutions Engineering

properties.serializedData:
{"version": "Notebook/1.0", "items": [{"type": 1, "content": {"json": "## Abstract Security × Microsoft Sentinel — Value & ROI
Abstract normalizes, **aggregates, deduplicates, enriches, and risk-scores** security telemetry *before* it reaches Sentinel — so the SOC ingests **fewer, richer, detection-ready events instead of raw noise.** This dashboard quantifies the enterprise win across three levers: **volume & cost reduction**, **normalization & enrichment coverage**, and **detection / hunt / AI-SOC effectiveness.**

Set your Sentinel price per GB and (optionally) your pre-Abstract source volume in the parameters below to translate reduction directly into dollars saved."}}, {"type": 9, "content": {"version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "parameters": [{"id": "prm-time", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "TimeRange", "label": "Time range", "type": 4, "isRequired": true, "typeSettings": {"selectableValues": [{"durationMs": 86400000}, {"durationMs": 604800000}, {"durationMs": 2592000000}, {"durationMs": 7776000000}]}, "value": {"durationMs": 2592000000}}, {"id": "prm-price", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "PricePerGB", "label": "Sentinel price / GB (USD)", "type": 1, "isRequired": true, "value": "2.30", "description": "Analytics-tier commitment/PAYG price per ingested GB. Adjust to your rate."}, {"id": "prm-src", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "SourceGBPerDay", "label": "Pre-Abstract source GB / day (optional)", "type": 1, "value": "0", "description": "Your measured daily volume BEFORE Abstract routing/filtering. Leave 0 to skip upstream-filtering savings."}], "style": "pills", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"}, "name": "parameters"}, {"type": 1, "content": {"json": "### 📉 Reduction & cost — fewer, richer events, a lower ingest bill"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| extend agg = todouble(coalesce(toreal(AbstractEvent.aggregation_count), 1.0)), b = todouble(estimate_data_size(AbstractEvent))
| summarize IngestedEvents = count(), RawEventsRepresented = sum(agg), IngestedBytes = sum(b)
| extend IngestedGB = round(IngestedBytes/1024.0/1024/1024, 3)
| extend AvgBytesPerEvent = iff(IngestedEvents>0, IngestedBytes/IngestedEvents, 0.0)
| extend AggregationRatio = round(iff(IngestedEvents>0, RawEventsRepresented/IngestedEvents, 1.0), 2)
| extend AvoidedEvents = RawEventsRepresented - IngestedEvents
| extend AvoidedGB = round((AvoidedEvents * AvgBytesPerEvent)/1024.0/1024/1024, 3)
| extend price = toreal('{PricePerGB}'), srcGBday = toreal('{SourceGBPerDay}')
| extend IngestCostForPeriod = round(IngestedGB * price, 2)
| extend AggregationSavings = round(AvoidedGB * price, 2)
| extend UpstreamFilterSavings = round(iff(srcGBday>0, max_of(srcGBday - IngestedGB, 0.0) * price, 0.0), 2)
| project ['Ingested events']=IngestedEvents, ['Raw events represented']=RawEventsRepresented, ['Aggregation ratio (raw:ingested)']=AggregationRatio, ['Ingested GB']=IngestedGB, ['Sentinel cost (period, $)']=IngestCostForPeriod, ['Saved by aggregation/dedupe ($)']=AggregationSavings, ['Saved by upstream filtering ($)']=UpstreamFilterSavings", "size": 1, "title": "Reduction & cost summary", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table", "gridSettings": {"formatters": [{"columnMatch": "Aggregation ratio (raw:ingested)", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "green"}}, {"columnMatch": "Saved by aggregation/dedupe ($)", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "greenDark"}}, {"columnMatch": "Saved by upstream filtering ($)", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "greenDark"}}]}}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| extend agg = todouble(coalesce(toreal(AbstractEvent.aggregation_count), 1.0))
| summarize ['Raw events represented']=sum(agg), ['Ingested into Sentinel']=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart", "size": 0, "title": "Raw events represented vs. ingested (aggregation/dedupe at work)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "timechart"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| extend product = tostring(AbstractEvent.product), b = todouble(estimate_data_size(AbstractEvent))
| summarize IngestedGB = round(sum(b)/1024.0/1024/1024, 4) by product
| top 15 by IngestedGB desc
| render barchart", "size": 0, "title": "Ingested GB by product (top cost drivers)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}}, {"type": 1, "content": {"json": "### 🧪 Normalization & enrichment — richer events, resolved upstream"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| extend e = AbstractEvent
| extend risk = toreal(e.risk_score), mr = e.matched_rules, tg = e.tags
| summarize Total = count(),
    RiskScored = countif(isnotnull(risk) and risk > 0),
    RuleMatched = countif(array_length(todynamic(mr)) > 0),
    Tagged = countif(array_length(todynamic(tg)) > 0),
    EnrichedIdentities = dcountif(tostring(e.identity), isnotempty(tostring(e.identity)))
| extend ['% risk-scored'] = round(100.0*RiskScored/Total, 1), ['% rule-matched'] = round(100.0*RuleMatched/Total, 1), ['% tagged'] = round(100.0*Tagged/Total, 1)
| project ['Events']=Total, ['% risk-scored'], ['% rule-matched'], ['% tagged'], ['Enriched identities']=EnrichedIdentities", "size": 1, "title": "Enrichment coverage (scored / rule-matched / tagged upstream)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table", "gridSettings": {"formatters": [{"columnMatch": "% risk-scored", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "blue"}}, {"columnMatch": "% rule-matched", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "purple"}}, {"columnMatch": "% tagged", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "turquoise"}}]}}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| extend severity = tostring(AbstractEvent.severity)
| summarize Events = count() by severity
| render piechart", "size": 0, "title": "Events by severity (post-pipeline)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "piechart"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "ASim_AbstractEvent
| where isnotempty(AbstractIdentity)
| summarize TotalRisk = round(sum(EventRiskScore),1), Events = count(), Products = dcount(EventProduct) by ActorUsername
| where TotalRisk > 0
| top 10 by TotalRisk desc
| render barchart", "size": 0, "title": "Top cumulative-risk identities (cross-product signal Abstract scores upstream)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}}, {"type": 1, "content": {"json": "### 🛡️ Detection, hunts & AI SOC — coverage that compounds
Analytics rules and hunts run over the Abstract-normalized surface, so every detection fires on higher-fidelity, pre-enriched data. The Verdict playbook (Abstract ASTRO) auto-triages insights, and Tune-at-source converts a false-positive disposition into an upstream filter — *permanently lowering future ingest and future incident volume*."}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "SecurityAlert
| where AlertName startswith 'Abstract'
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertName, AlertSeverity
| render barchart", "size": 0, "title": "Alerts raised by Abstract analytics rules", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "SecurityIncident
| where Title startswith 'Abstract' or Title has 'Abstract'
| summarize Incidents = count() by Status, Severity
| render barchart", "size": 0, "title": "Abstract-originated incidents by status / severity", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "SecurityIncident
| where Title has 'Abstract'
| where Classification in ('FalsePositive','BenignPositive')
| summarize FalsePositives = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart", "size": 0, "title": "False-positive dispositions → candidates for Tune-at-source (future ingest avoided)", "timeContextFromParameter": "TimeRange", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "timechart"}}, {"type": 1, "content": {"json": "### Why Abstract × Sentinel — better together
- **Cost**: aggregation, deduplication, and upstream filtering cut ingested GB at the source — the *aggregation ratio* above is measured directly from `aggregation_count`, and the cost model prices exactly what you avoided ingesting.
- **Signal & coverage**: events arrive normalized, pre-enriched, and risk-scored, so analytics and hunts fire on higher-fidelity data and identity/IP risk is correlated **across products** — a cross-source signal the SIEM alone rarely assembles.
- **AI SOC**: the Verdict playbook auto-triages Abstract insights; Tune-at-source closes the loop by pushing false-positive dispositions back into the pipeline as filters — each one permanently lowers future ingest **and** future incident volume.

*A SIEM-only or detection-only vendor can't tell this story — only a pipeline can act at the source.*"}}], "styleSettings": {}, "$schema": "https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json"}
